listing.name: Project MISTRAL - a Diable/ArmaA Expansion Mod
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new faction of former Diable Avionics rebels and a set of Diable-styled ships with Arma Armatura strikecraft.

description:
[0.98a] Project MISTRAL

This mod adds:

New faction: Angelos Contingent: A faction of former Diable Avionics rebels with a luddic tilt, operating out of the Angelos trinary system near diable space. (generates mid-save)
Currently includes 1 contact with rewards at 25, 50, 75, 100 rep, and a unique officer specializing in piloting Diable strikecraft.
Includes basic Nexerelin compatibility.

New ships:
Diable Avionics hulls with some Arma Armatura Strikecraft. Ships from this mod forego micro-missiles for a more up-close playstyle.

- Ame: A traditional frigate, a Diable-styled take on the wolf.
- Sparrow: Missile-focused strikecraft wanzer with some calm-style defensive drones.
- Hummingbird: Light strikecraft wanzer with temporal shell and attack drones.
- Typhoon: A heavily armed Rime variant.
- Stormsurge: Variant of the Gust with no bays, more guns, and phase grazer.
- Tailwind: Heavy carrier based on the Gulf, with more bays, armaa recall system, and a special subsystem that can buff the strongest nearby strikecraft or fighter.
- Sunrain: A variant of the Traverser Sunshower with more bays, phase grazer, and a dual version of the tailwind buffing subsystem.
All ships include red skins as magic paintjobs will full weapon and fighter color-swapping for the Diable purists.

DOWNLOAD

REQUIREMENTS

This mod currently REQUIRES Arma Armatura 3.2.6+
and REQUIRES EITHER the Caymon Joestar OR "Original Flavor" version of Diable Avionics (due to skin compatibility reqs).
Also Magiclib, lazylib, lunalib.

Find Arma Armatura here

Find Diable Avionics-Joestar edition here
Find Diable Avionics: Original Flavor here

Also compatible with Diable Armaaonics, a separate project working on directly porting the base Diable Wanzers into Armaa strikecraft.
Find Diable Armaaonics here

SHIPS

Spoiler
???, Hummingbird, Sparrow, and Ame

Typhoon, Stormsurge, and Tailwind

Sunrain

CREDITS

Spoiler
Credits to:
Selkie for heavy collaboration and sprites, she drew the Ame and Stormsurge with help from Snazzypantsmcgree.
Yogurt Fox (who drew the DA skin for Sunshower), Shinsou (Traverser artist) and Hanliu (Traverser author) for their permission to use the excellent Sunshower (DA) sprite and elements for the VLS missiles, as well as Mycophobia for helping facilitate communication/translation with our CN friends! This mod would not be here if this sprite did not inspire me!
Timid/Selkie for their work on Iron Shell which several parts of this mods code are based off, as well as some parts of KOL code and all those who worked on that mod.

Flashfrozen/Tartiflette for their work on Diable Avionics, and all those who worked on the mod.
Shoi for their work on Armaa and all those who have worked on that mod, which several parts of this mod are based off. This mod is as much an armaa sub-mod as it is Diable!
Caymen and Rogo for some assets/inspiration from their "Nightingale" Wanzer and their work on Diable.
Yuki, Noof, WMGreywind, Aero, Tidal, Histi, Crab, ApogeeKnight, Vexlia for some inspiration/code/help.
Portraits are painted over/recolored/touched up official art from the tabletop game, Infinity.
Music is from PSOBB.

(hope I didn't forget anyone)

Claude Code AI was used for code assistance and file formatting. No AI was used in art, writing, or descriptions.

NOTES

There is also a lunalib option to enable some depreciated bounties from the 0.1 version with some additional ships. I have not had the chance to rework them with the re-design of the faction. These include the MISTRAL, a large capital-sized bakraid, the Sunshower (DA) which is closer to the Traverser Sunshower than the Sunrain, and the Discordant, a gunboat 4-large pandemonium variant with the classic flicker system.

Also a hullmod accessible via lunalib options to change the engine aesthetics of Diable ships from a "flicker" to a pulsing glow.

NOT SAVE COMPATIBLE IF YOU WERE USING THE OLD 0.1 VERSION FROM DISCORD.

FUTURE

I have plans to flesh out lore, quests, ships, ect. This is my first real mod and has been a lot of fun to work on! Going to take a bit of a break to game and try out some new mod updates before I resume work.
